SELECT   
case when 
CAST(max([iTracker_Import_date]) AS DATE)  = cast(getdate() as date)  then 1 else 0 end as flag

FROM 
[PLHS].[dbo].[tbl_VulnActive_Daily_Static]

USE [PLHS] GO declare @yesterday date set @yesterday = (select BusinessDay from Calendar where CurrentDate = cast(getdate() as date)) -- TODO: Set parameter values here. INSERT INTO [dbo].[tbl_ssis_utility] ([To] ,[Subject] ,[body] ,[ReceiveDate] ,[SendDate] ,[BodyFormat] ,[CC] ) SELECT 'greg.wilkinson@wellsfargo.com;michael.dematos@wellsfargo.com;sergio.dsilva@wellsfargo.com;tim.kemen@wellsfargo.com;riyaz.sheikh@wellsfargo.com' ,'New/Re-Activated EM/HA vulnerability Alert' , cast('The following list of Emergency/HA CombID have been identified as not being included in the pervious days Extract, validate with iTracker History ' +string_agg('
'+a.CombID,',
')+'
' as ntext) as body ,GETDATE() as receivedate ,null as senddate ,2 as bodyformat ,'ethan.a.baker@wellsfargo.com;mark.bray@wellsfargo.com' as CC FROM tbl_VulnActive_Daily_Static a left outer join iTracker_Active_SN_CIO b on a.combid = b.combid and cast(b.ImportDate as date) =@yesterday WHERE Rating_Summary ='Emergency/HA' and b.CombID is null

SELECT 
CASE WHEN COUNT(ReceiveDate) > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS CompareFlag
 FROM tbl_ssis_utility
WHERE SUBJECT ='New/Re-Activated EM/HA vulnerability Alert'
AND CAST(RECEIVEDATE AS DATE) = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE);

declare @toprun datetime = (SELECT
max(ReceiveDate)
 FROM tbl_ssis_utility
WHERE SUBJECT ='New/Re-Activated EM/HA vulnerability Alert'
AND CAST(RECEIVEDATE AS DATE) = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) )

declare @Lastrun datetime = (SELECT
max(ReceiveDate)
 FROM tbl_ssis_utility
WHERE SUBJECT ='New/Re-Activated EM/HA vulnerability Alert'
AND CAST(RECEIVEDATE AS DATE) = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) )
;

with 
toprun as 
( select id, CAST(body AS nvarchar(MAX)) as body from tbl_ssis_utility where ReceiveDate =@toprun and  [SUBJECT] ='New/Re-Activated EM/HA vulnerability Alert' ) 
,
lastrun as 
( select id,CAST(body AS nvarchar(MAX))  as body from tbl_ssis_utility where ReceiveDate =@toprun and  [SUBJECT] ='New/Re-Activated EM/HA vulnerability Alert' ) 
, ID as 
(
select 
a.*,b.body as bd2 from
toprun a
inner join lastrun b on  a.body = b.body
)
delete a 
from tbl_ssis_utility  a
inner join id b on  a.ID = b.ID and b.bd2 is not null
